title: Delhivery partners with Tata Motors, Euler Motors, Montra Electric to deploy up to 2,000 electric commercial vehicles
summary: The pacts are part of the company's plan to put close to 5,000 EVs into operation within three years.
llm_summary: Delhivery has struck deals with Tata Motors, Euler Motors and Montra Electric to add up to 2,000 electric commercial vehicles to its fleet. The partnerships are a key step toward the logistics firm’s broader goal of operating roughly 5,000 EVs within the next three years, accelerating its shift to a greener, zero‑emission delivery network.
